ops.old: Flathead in a crisp beer batter, fried golden, with double-fried chips, homemade tartare with capers and gherkins, and lemon wedges. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Whisk 150g plain flour and 50g cornflour with 300ml cold lager and a pinch of salt. Dust 8 flathead fillets in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayo with chopped capers, gherkins, parsley and lemon juice for tartare.
